snippet.title: Tormentum II – Official Launch Trailer | Dark Point-and-Click Adventure
snippet.description:
After almost eight years of work, Tormentum II is finally ready. This is the official launch trailer for our hand-drawn, dark point-and-click adventure, coming to Steam on July 23, 2026.

Play the free demo and add Tormentum II to your Steam wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/931060/Tormentum_II/

David is creating a simulation whose inhabitants think and feel like real people. After he installs a mysterious coprocessor, he wakes up inside the world he made. Something is wrong. The simulation contains places he never designed, hostile creatures and gods that should not exist.

We drew 200 scenes for Tormentum II. With close-ups, the game contains almost 500 individual backgrounds. A playthrough takes about 8 to 12 hours, depending on how you explore and solve the puzzles. The choices you make affect the people David meets and can lead to different endings.

The visual world was inspired by the work of H. R. Giger and Zdzisław Beksiński.

This is a standalone story. You do not need to play Tormentum: Dark Sorrow first.

Tormentum II was made by OhNoo Studio, a two-person independent team from Poland.

Release date: July 23, 2026
Platforms: Windows, macOS and SteamOS/Linux
Developer and publisher: OhNoo Studio

Learn more:
https://www.ohnoo.com/

Press kit, screenshots and game information:
https://www.ohnoo.com/tormentum_II_press.html

#TormentumII #PointAndClick #IndieGame #adventuregame #darkgame
